instruction:
Create apps/web/src/lib/board-filter-params.ts exporting helper functions and types for board search parameters:
1. Export type BoardSearchParams = { taskId?: string; status?: string[]; priority?: string[]; assignee?: string[]; dueDate?: string[]; labels?: string[] }.
2. Export function validateBoardSearch(search: Record<string, unknown>): BoardSearchParams. It must never throw. For each filter key ('status', 'priority', 'assignee', 'dueDate', 'labels'): if the value is an array, take strings, trim them, filter out empty strings; if it is a single string, trim it, and if non-empty wrap in a 1-element array; if the key is empty string, whitespace, missing, or invalid, omit it (leave undefined). Do NOT split strings on commas. Cap any filter array at 50 elements. Preserve taskId if it is a non-empty string.
3. Export function filtersToSearchParams(filters: BoardFilters): Partial<BoardSearchParams>. Map non-empty string arrays from BoardFilters to BoardSearchParams, omitting null or empty array properties (undefined).
4. Export function searchParamsToFilters(params: BoardSearchParams): BoardFilters. Convert BoardSearchParams back into BoardFilters with null defaults for absent/empty keys.
5. Export function hasActiveFilterParams(params: Partial<BoardSearchParams> | undefined | null): boolean. Return true if any filter key ('status', 'priority', 'assignee', 'dueDate', 'labels') contains an array with at least one non-empty string, else false.
acceptance: Exports BoardSearchParams, validateBoardSearch, filtersToSearchParams, searchParamsToFilters, and hasActiveFilterParams
validateBoardSearch never throws on null, undefined, primitive, object, or corrupted inputs
validateBoardSearch normalizes bare single strings, repeated keys, and JSON arrays to string arrays without comma splitting
validateBoardSearch caps arrays at 50 elements
hasActiveFilterParams returns false for empty strings, whitespace, empty arrays, or missing filter keys
filtersToSearchParams returns an object omitting inactive/empty keys

instruction:
Refactor useTaskFiltersWithLabelsSupport in apps/web/src/hooks/use-task-filters-with-labels-support.ts to derive filter state directly from route search params:
1. Update signature to:
export function useTaskFiltersWithLabelsSupport(
  project: ProjectWithTasks | null | undefined,
  projectId?: string,
  textQuery?: string,
  searchFilters?: BoardSearchParams,
  onFiltersChange?: (next: BoardFilters) => void
)
2. Remove React useState for filters and any isInitializedRef. Derive filters synchronously using useMemo(() => searchFilters ? searchParamsToFilters(searchFilters) : DEFAULT_FILTERS, [searchFilters]).
3. LocalStorage persistence:
- Seed on mount: if hasActiveFilterParams(searchFilters) is false, read localStorage.getItem(storageKey). If valid stored filters exist, seed URL by calling onFiltersChange?.(storedFilters). Guard seed with seededStorageKeyRef (useRef<string | null>(null)) so it runs once per projectId.
- Sync-back effect: a useEffect that runs only when hasActiveFilterParams(searchFilters) is true, writing localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(filters)).
- Delete any filters-keyed localStorage mirror effect.
4. Write-on-mutation: updateFilter, updateLabelFilter, and clearFilters must compute nextFilters, write localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(nextFilters)), and invoke onFiltersChange?.(nextFilters).
5. Hook must NOT call useNavigate or any router hooks.
acceptance: Hook signature accepts (project, projectId?, textQuery?, searchFilters?, onFiltersChange?)
filters is derived synchronously via useMemo without useState
Hook does not import or call useNavigate
When searchFilters has no active filter params, reads localStorage and seeds via onFiltersChange once per projectId
When searchFilters has active filter params, syncs filters to localStorage
updateFilter, updateLabelFilter, and clearFilters write localStorage and call onFiltersChange

instruction:
Create unit tests in apps/web/src/lib/board-filter-params.test.ts testing all helper functions in board-filter-params.ts:
1. validateBoardSearch never throws on null, numbers, corrupted objects, or prototypes.
2. Round-trips all 5 dimensions (status, priority, assignee, dueDate, labels) through filtersToSearchParams and searchParamsToFilters.
3. Normalizes bare single strings, repeated query params, and JSON array strings into string arrays.
4. Rejects comma-splitting: '?status=todo,review' must parse as single string ['todo,review'].
5. Caps array length at 50 items.
6. hasActiveFilterParams returns false for empty strings (?status=), whitespace (?status=%20), empty arrays, and null/undefined, and true for valid values.
acceptance: Tests cover validateBoardSearch never-throw guarantees
Tests verify round-trip conversions for all 5 filter dimensions
Tests verify inbound normalization of bare strings, repeated keys, and JSON arrays without comma splitting
Tests verify 50-item array length cap
Tests verify hasActiveFilterParams truth table for edge cases and whitespace

instruction:
Rework apps/web/src/hooks/use-task-filters-with-labels-support.test.tsx for the URL-as-source-of-truth hook.
IMPORTANT — the file has two existing tests and they are NOT equally portable:
(a) The it.each(["#123","proj-123","proj-"]) issue-identifier test uses only (project, "project-1", textQuery) and has no localStorage dependency. KEEP IT VERBATIM. It must still pass unchanged.
(b) The "restores persisted label filters from storage" test calls the hook with (project, "project-1") and asserts result.current.filters.labels equals ["label-bug"]. Under the new design filters derive from searchFilters, so with no searchFilters and no onFiltersChange this test CANNOT pass as written. REWRITE it: seed localStorage, pass an onFiltersChange spy, mount, and assert the spy was called once with { labels: ["label-bug"] } (the seed publishes to the URL rather than into hook state). Then separately assert that passing searchFilters={ labels: ["label-bug"] } yields filters.labels === ["label-bug"] and filters the project to task-1 only.
Then ADD tests:
1. filters derive synchronously from searchFilters on first render (no waitFor needed).
2. URL precedence: searchFilters status=["in_progress"] with localStorage holding status=["todo"] yields filters.status ["in_progress"] AND writes ["in_progress"] to localStorage.
3. Cold mount, no active URL params, localStorage populated: onFiltersChange called exactly once; calling again with the same projectId does not re-seed.
4. Empty param: searchFilters={ status: [] } (the normalized form of ?status=) still triggers the localStorage seed.
5. updateFilter, updateLabelFilter and clearFilters each write localStorage and call onFiltersChange with the next filters.
Never assert expect.any(Function).
acceptance: The it.each issue-identifier test is unchanged and passes
The label-restore test is rewritten to assert the onFiltersChange seed spy rather than hook state, and passes
A test proves filters derive synchronously from searchFilters on first render
A test proves URL params win over localStorage and are written back to localStorage
A test proves the localStorage seed fires exactly once per projectId
A test proves an empty/normalized-away param still allows the localStorage seed
A test proves updateFilter, updateLabelFilter and clearFilters each persist and notify
No assertion uses expect.any(Function)
